name: Mediterranean Roasted Eggplant
description: This Mediterranean Roasted Eggplant is a celebration of flavors and texture that truly showcases the beauty of this versatile vegetable. This dish is not just about the eggplant, though; it’s infused with Mediterranean spices and ingredients like garlic, olive oil, and fresh herbs, which add depth and brightness to every bite.
author: Emily
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Slice the eggplants into 1-inch rounds and place them in a large bowl.
Drizzle the olive oil over the eggplant slices and sprinkle with garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Toss the eggplant slices until they are evenly coated with the oil and spices.
Spread the seasoned eggplant slices in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until the eggplant is tender and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and garnish with freshly chopped parsley before serving.
